company.name: Double Robotics
company.shortDescription: Double Robotics, the developer of an iPad-based tele-presence robot, is focused on building innovative products in the field of robotics.
company.description:
Double Robotics is the creator of Double, the world’s leading telepresence robot. We help telecommuters feel more connected to their colleagues by giving them a physical presence wherever they need to be.

Having your own Double in the office means you can be free to roam around anywhere without scheduling a call or meeting. Double takes everything you love about video calls on an iPad and puts that on a mobile base that puts the remote worker in control. By combining cutting edge technology with an intuitive, elegant design, Double is the ultimate tool for telecommuters. 

Our mission is to connect the world through remote experiences.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile telepresence robot that uses an iPad for remote video communication and navigation, enabling users to be virtually present in a distant location.
productsAndServices.name: Double Telepresence Robot

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,643,229 to $13,644,949, a 1.41x increase.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 69 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 1 (-13).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
